commit_subject: perf(pdf): a font's glyph outlines are unpacked once a session, not once per letter of every preview build (PERF-1)
commit_body:
Cause: every font the PDF prints is a .woff (the bundled Noto Sans and every Fontsource face), and fontkit's WOFFFont._getTableStream inflates the whole compressed glyf table again each time it is asked for it. It is asked per glyph: twice for every glyph a PDF embeds (TTFSubset._addGlyph and TTFGlyph._decode) and once for a glyph's bounding box. Each preview is a new PDF with new subsets, so every keystroke's build re-inflated each face's ~11 kB table (17.7 kB inflated) once or twice per distinct glyph it printed. R2-142 left this open (97-font-cache only pins that font files are fetched once).

Fix: prepareFonts keeps a WOFF face's inflated glyf table with the face (pdfFontLoader.js, inflateGlyfOnce). The first request inflates it through fontkit's own method; every later one gets a fresh stream over the same bytes at 0, as fontkit's own is, so no two readers share a position. Other tables are already decoded once by fontkit (TTFFont._getTable). react-pdf keeps each loaded face for the session, in the main thread and in the PDF worker alike, so the cache lives as long as the face.

Test: tests/pdf/97-woff-glyf-once loads the bundled Noto Sans before any build, counts each face's glyf inflations over two résumé builds and a cover letter (at most one per face; without the fix, hundreds), checks the kept bytes equal fontkit's own inflation, and that the PDFs read as typed. 97-font-cache's header no longer calls this part open.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
notes: Confirmed at d11d5a0: fontkit 2.0.4 (the only copy; @react-pdf/pdfkit embeds the same fontkit object pdfFontLoader primes) WOFFFont._getTableStream inflates glyf on every call, and TTFSubset._addGlyph / TTFGlyph._decode / _getCBox call it per glyph; all six Noto Sans latin faces store glyf compressed (checked the files: 11.0-11.8 kB -> 17.7-18.3 kB). The fetch/parse-per-build half was already fixed (97-font-cache, 9ac453d); fonts are loaded once per worker too (the worker keeps its registry for the session), so nothing there changed. The root fix is in src/templates/pdf/shared/pdfFontLoader.js, not the files the item listed (fonts.js, fontsource.js, pdfWorker.js hold no font decoding). The test needs react-pdf's Font store, so it adds tests/fixtures/reactPdfFont.js (a one-line re-export loaded through the harness's Vite instance, the same way tests load tests/fixtures/sampleResumes.js); fail-first undoes only src/, so the fixture stays and the test fails on the inflation count. Not stacked on R2-147-pn (it touches no font file). Not run locally (owner's rule). The rest of R2-142's PERF-1 (the N1/N2 perf harness and the Gate A/B browser spec) is not part of this item.
reviewed: Bug real at d11d5a0 (fontkit 2.0.4 WOFFFont._getTableStream re-inflates glyf per call; TTFSubset._addGlyph/_decode/_getCBox call it per glyph; pdfkit uses the store font object directly); fix wraps the instance once per face behind primedFonts, returns a fresh DecodeStream at pos 0 over cached bytes (readBuffer slices, compound path copies, so no shared-state mutation); every face goes through prepareFonts; failfirst counts readBuffer(compLength-2) at offset+2 = fontkit inflate, fails without src (hundreds) and passes with (<=1); face order 400n/500n/700n matches registerFaces; git apply --check clean; no a11y/locale/tracking edits.
